entities.summary: Karl Rabe was an automobile designer and was the chief designer at Porsche. He helped Ferdinand Porsche to develop the Porsche's transmissions. He kept a detailed diary while working for Porsche, which has aided historians. He was born in Pottendorf, Austria.
